system.longDesc:
The weapon’s grip has sensors allowing it to read finger- and palm-prints, and it unlocks its safeties only for authorized users. This prevents a weapon from being taken and used against its owner. In some cyberpunk settings, a biometric lock might also be remote-controlled, such as in the case of a security or police force who can only use certain weapons with permission from their higher-ups at headquarters.

Resources TN 13.
